claims.text: Many reviewers find these wipes gentle and non-irritating, especially suitable for sensitive skin.
Reviewers frequently praise the wipes for effectively removing makeup, including eye makeup and mascara.
Several reviewers appreciate the exfoliating bumps/texture, though some dislike the bumps or find the wipes too scrubby for frequent use.
Some reviewers report the wipes are not wet enough, requiring extra wiping or pressure, and one notes eye redness for contact lens wearers.
Reviewers value the convenience of the wipes for travel, post-workout, or saving time.
